whatThisProves: The Mod really dispatched Farmer.doEmote(happy) on the game thread: the receipt carries nativeDispatched=true, which the Mod only writes after it wakes to isEmoting.
The Mod really dispatched Farmer.faceDirection(left): the receipt reasonCode actor_facing_matches is only emitted after the native FacingDirection equals the requested value.
Both are distinct native executions (separate executionIds), and revisions advance monotonically 0 -> 1 -> 2 with no activeExecution left behind.
The player-visible effect (the emote bubble over the companion's head) is the same one a human observed under the retired SDW-LIVE-COOP-01 scenario.
whatThisDoesNotProve: No cancellation, deadline, watchdog, replay or migration coverage for these two actions.
No multiplayer coverage. Both actions are mp-insensitive / single_player_native_companion, so single-player live is the topology they require.
No visual confirmation was captured in this run; the receipt is the authority here.
